name: What should I look for when choosing a general contractor for home repairs?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a general contractor for home repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a general contractor, look for proper licensing and insurance for your protection. Check their experience with similar repairs and review customer testimonials or portfolios. A reputable contractor will offer a clear, written estimate, communicate transparently, and guarantee their work. Always prioritize professionalism and a strong track record to ensure quality results for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for licensing, insurance, experience, clear estimates, good communication, and positive reviews when choosing a contractor.
